top_signals.title: Compounding Is 8th Wonder of the World, Says KKR's McVey
top_signals.summary: Henry McVey, partner, head of global macro and asset allocation and CIO of the KKR's balance sheet, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss private markets, asset allocation, 401K's and retirement security. (Source: Bloomberg)
